description: Real pinned Ibex (ibex_top) as the instruction+data OBI master pair with the real pinned OpenTitan uart as a TL-UL MMIO target. This is the request that composes a component whose whole bus is two packed struct ports: the uart's tl_i/tl_d2h_t boundary is bound member by member, rendered as one member-wise connection per struct port, and re-read by the independent structure audit. Memory, clock, reset and address policy are the same shape as request-ibex.json.
